craft_notes: Sthāyin: Vismaya at unknowable workings, settling into plea. Comma→colon after Height (musing done, vaunt released). Vṛtti shine-forth kept. Rejected: 'pride' gloss for smaya — kept vaunt. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: 'Why this vaunt?' — mused in heart, O Sovereign Height:
'vaunting, I am thine-made' — ah me, unselfed: what glee?
l4.sanskrit_cite: kiṃ smayeneti matvāpi manasā parameśvara smayena tvanmayo 'smīti māmi nātmani kiṃ mudā

reads_against.argmap: 'What with pride?' having even thought with mind, O Supreme Lord. → Thinking pride, claiming made-of-you, yet not in self — what joy?
c1_essence: Pride claiming made-of-you yet not in self; rest in mind-bliss after weighing duties.

l2.plain_english: Thinking in mind, 'why this pride?', O highest Lord — 'proud, I am made of you' — ah me, not in myself: what joy is this?
